patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-resolution automotive photography and video dominate key sections, often with dark overlays for text legibility.
Content sections frequently alternate between dark (black/dark grey) and light (white/light grey) backgrounds to create visual rhythm and delineate content.
Headings use a clean, modern sans-serif typeface in varying weights, with subheadings and labels often set in uppercase for a sophisticated feel.
The hero section features a full-width image carousel (using swiper) that transitions smoothly between different vehicle visuals, accompanied by subtle text changes.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining access to key links as the user scrolls down the page.
Product showcases consistently use a grid of cards, each featuring a vehicle image, model name, and brief details, with a clear call to action.

technique_notes: A persistent, dark-themed header navigation is fixed to the top of the viewport, ensuring continuous access to site navigation elements.
Hero sections are implemented as full-bleed image carousels, likely using a library like Swiper, with text overlays that dynamically adapt to the background imagery for optimal contrast.
Content sections are introduced with subtle scroll-triggered animations, such as a gentle fade-in or slide-up effect, as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) are paired with smaller, often uppercase, sans-serif labels (~0.8x body) for a modern, authoritative feel.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; buttons and cards have slightly rounded corners, but overall forms are sharp and precise.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced; generous vertical spacing between major sections creates an airy feel, while internal content grids maintain a tighter, organized rhythm.

standout: The site's distinctive use of dramatic, cinematic full-bleed photography and video for its hero and key product sections, combined with a predominantly dark, minimalist aesthetic, creates an exceptionally premium and aspirational brand experience. It prioritizes visual impact and emotional connection over detailed specifications on the homepage.
